questions.source_content:
OFFICIAL NOTICE
Directorate of Treasuries & Accounts, Kota
Date: 14 March 2025 (Ref No: RAJ/221)
Subject: Annual Door-to-Door Verification Camp for Social Security Pension Beneficiaries (Phase-2)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Kota division are hereby informed that under 'Annual Door-to-Door Verification Camp for Social Security Pension Beneficiaries', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 19 March in the central registers wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #321) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Kota, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and registers movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Kota), 2. Budget Reconciliation #131, 3. Digital Indexing.
Deputy Director (Administration)
Neeraj Kumar Verma
solution_steps: 1. Select the first line.
2. Click Underline (U), set Font Size to '18', and pick a Font Color.
